concerns.text: FR-006 mandates ENFORCEMENT of ≤7 GB with 'automatically sampling or subsetting data if necessary', and plan.md Phase 1 assigns memory_monitor.py an adaptive fallback (per-subject streaming, then deterministic seeded subsetting, hard abort last resort). No task builds or tests this enforcement mechanism: the coverage table maps FR-006 only to T008, which merely RECORDS peak RAM in verification_run_summary.csv. The plan's memory-guard element is an orphan — add a task (or extend T002/T004) implementing and testing memory_monitor.py's subsetting fallback.

T008 creates code/visualization/plot_connectivity.py and plot_nbs.py, and every task's verification depends on code/tests/, but plan.md's Project Structure tree contains neither code/visualization/ nor code/tests/. The tasks reference codebase layout elements absent from the plan, so the plan and task list disagree on structure; either the plan tree must be updated or tasks must place these files in planned directories.

US-3 scenario 1 requires the correlation analysis to 'complete within 5 minutes', but no task or verification covers this runtime bound (SC-004/T008 cover only the 6-hour whole-pipeline limit). Add a runtime assertion or documented measurement to T006's verification.
